name: Cyberloom
summary: Sydney dialup ISP (launched Mar 1995); retail ISP ceased c. 2001, customers pushed to OzEmail email forwarding (CYBERLOOM PTY. LTD., ACN 070 228 938).

events.details: "Cyberloom is an Australian Internet Service Provider, launched in March 1995" (homepage, Wayback 11 Jan 1997).

Retail ISP ceased c. 2001; homepage (authored 28 Jun 2001) redirected to OzEmail offering a free Cyberloom email-forwarding account; by May 2002 an explicit "your Cyberloom Internet service has ceased" notice; domain parked (Easy CGI placeholder) by Aug 2006, later reused for an unrelated "loom design" site.
